name: Threshold from 1 January 2021: one hundred crore rupees

attrs.quote: with effect from the 1st day of January, 2021, for the words ―five hundred crore rupees‖, the words ―one hundred crore rupees‖ shall be substituted
attrs.scope: registered persons whose aggregate turnover in any preceding financial year from 2017-18 onwards exceeds the threshold, for supplies to registered persons or for exports
